description: Trusted transaction-confirmation window (R2+R3). Renders the backend-built signing summary and relays the user's approve/reject decision. Loads only the app's own bundle; the renderer cannot script into it, so it can neither forge nor suppress a confirmation. App commands (begin_sign/approve_sign/...) are reachable here because this window has a capability; the untrusted dapp-browser window deliberately has none.
